reconcile.note: Henry reads the single angel outside the tomb and the two angels inside as successive moments in one continuous scene, so each Gospel records only part of it.

discrepancy.note: Strauss lists the mismatched angel counts among the divergences the Gospels never resolve into one scene.

quotes.text: In Matthew they receive this information before they enter into the grave, from the angel, who after rolling away the stone had sat upon it. … she saw, according to this gospel, two angels in white, sitting, the one at the head and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined, trans. George Eliot (1846), ch. on the resurrection, on Matthew 28:2 and John 20:12.

sides.snippet: an angel of the Lord descended from the sky, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat on it
sides.verseText: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat on it.

sides.snippet: she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet
sides.verseText: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
